      Best time to meet

      9-to-5 working hours in London and Sydney do not overlap at all, so someone has to meet outside their usual hours. Suggested slot: 7:00 AM in London = 6:00 PM in Sydney.

      Time difference and daylight saving time

      In January: Sydney is 11 hours ahead of London. In July: Sydney is 9 hours ahead of London.

      London changes its clocks on March 28, 2027; October 31, 2027. Sydney changes its clocks on April 4, 2027; October 3, 2027.

      Public holidays 2027

      In 2027, there are 6 working days when only one side is on a public holiday (4 in London, 2 in Sydney). Plan deadlines around them.
